name: Terminal-RSI-27B

lineage.how_derived: RL for terminal agents: Recursive Self-Rewrite of verified trajectories plus Recursive Policy-Refine (PPO with an inherited critic), paper arXiv 2610.22192

purpose: Terminal-agent model for repository inspection, code editing, dependency repair and scientific workflow reconstruction (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0; LICENSE file present but text not read.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus full attention dense transformer (Qwen3.8-27B layout)
architecture.attention: full attention every 4th layer, hidden 5120, head dim 256

pc-12gb.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Arete-27B (17.2 GB); no quant checked
pc-12gb.notes: 17.2 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part of the dense weights stream from RAM (decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Arete-27B (17.2 GB); no quant checked
pc-16gb.notes: 17.2 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part of the dense weights stream from RAM (decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-24gb.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Arete-27B (17.2 GB); no quant checked
pc-24gb.notes: 17.2 GB file fits the VRAM budget (21.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-32gb.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Arete-27B (17.2 GB); no quant checked
pc-32gb.notes: 17.2 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Arete-27B (17.2 GB); no quant checked
mac-16-24gb.notes: 17.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Arete-27B (17.2 GB); no quant checked
mac-32gb.notes: 17.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Arete-27B (17.2 GB); no quant checked
mac-64gb+.notes: 17.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Qwen3.8-27B layout; GGUF conversion not checked.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1
benchmarks.variant: paper's retained RPR-2 step-18 model (card says the released checkpoint may differ), Mean@3; base measured 51.70 in the paper's harness (other vendors report 73.0 for Qwen3.8-27B)

strengths: terminal-agent RL on the model we already consider the 27B baseline
weaknesses: the paper-reported model and the released checkpoint are distinguished by the card; the base number (51.7) is far below other published Qwen3.8-27B Terminal-Bench 2.1 scores, so the gain is harness-dependent

tona_fit.reason: A terminal-agent RL fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B with a large reported gain; same machinery and memory as the base we already serve. Needs a run in our own harness against the stock model before any offer.
blockers: released checkpoint may differ from the paper's model

open_questions: which checkpoint the repo holds versus the paper's step-18 model
reproduction in a harness where the base scores 73
